meanings: smile (archaic), to listen to; to hear, to heed; to obey, a can (loanword from English "tin"), classifier for canned beverages, to let be; to allow (Taiwan pr. [tìng]), (literary) to administer; to deal with (Taiwan pr. [tìng])
(of a pupil) to write down (in a dictation exercise), dictation, (music) to transcribe by ear
